6. **Mobile Objects**: backpack_mara (entry_hook_e1/bedroom_floor_b1); lunchbox_mara (counter_k1 if prepping, else OUT_OF_HOUSE); suitcase_mara (bedroom_floor_b1/OUT_OF_HOUSE).

7. **Charger Logic**: charger_mara with laptop_mara (desk_b1) or phone_mara (entry_table_e1/backpack_mara).

8. **Water Bottle**: water_bottle_mara moves with Mara (desk_b1, kitchen_table_k1, couch_l1).

9. **Vacuum & Watering Can**: vacuum_cleaner_shared_1 (entry_floor_e1/bedroom_floor_b1); watering_can_mara (kitchen/OUT_OF_HOUSE).

10. **Misplacement**: Low. Items stay in home spot. If missing, check last active room. Do not assume items are moved just because resident is absent.

11. **ON_PERSON**: Rare. Only phone/keys/wallet when moving. Objects are placed down.

12. **OUT_OF_HOUSE**: Only suitcase_mara, lunchbox_mara (work), umbrella_mara (rain).", "why": "Previous belief that resident absence lowers static item probability was incorrect.
